## Project Menu Configuration Files (YAML)
Each project in the Prismata workspace which includes 'CLI_Menu' in PROJECT_INTERFACES contains a project.menus folder outlining the projects menu labels and metadata.

The menus folder will be placed in each respective projects root folder /project.menus

Individual menu files within the project.menus folder must start with the filename prefix "menu_" and match the id field of the menu itself.
